profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Pokémon Company International
profile.summary:
I am a passionate software and hardware developer with interests in gaming, home automation, photography, and travel. I would categorize myself as a tinkerer/maker who loves to create and learn fast.

Currently active in Gaming, Mobile, Web, and IoT development:
• Unity, iOS, Windows 10
• C#, HTML5, Node.js, AngularJS, GoLang
• Arduino, Particle, Raspberry Pi, 3D Design in Blender, Photoshop, After Effects

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
•	Co-founded a gaming studio with the popular League of Legends live-streamer “BoxBox” to bring a PVP deckbuilding fighting game to market as well as other Twitch stream extensions
•	Full stack development of an online competitive card game launched via Steam using Unity, AWS, and Firebase.
•	Grew the development team to over 20 contractors, artists, musicians, voice actors, designers, and developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Microsoft Teams - UX & Framework
• Worked on the launch of Microsoft Teams (teams.microsoft.com)
• Developed key framework components in authentication and cross browser compatibility.
• Implemented UX designs in HTML5 using SASS and AngularJS.

Partner App Experiences - R&D
• Helped companies develop Universal Windows Applications

Internet Of Things - Dev R&D
• Developed a piano running on Windows shown during the keynote speech of //build/ 2014.
• Worked to implement, productize, and ship the Windows Developer Program for IoT and Windows on Galileo SDK
• Implemented an Arduino compatible API for Windows on Intel Galileo
• Open Sourced Windows IoT content and packages on Github
• Working with the open source community to support and improve the Windows IoT offering
• Worked on the creation of Windows 10 IoT Core on Raspberry Pi 2 & 3, MinnowBoard Max, and Dragonboard 410c.
• Brokered a partnership with Hackster.io

positions.title: SDET in Windows Embedded Automotive

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a contract developer to create custom UI graphs, dashboard, and onboarding experience for a startup based in the Cryptocurrency accounting space.

positions.description: Organized curriculum and taught students how to program in Objective-C and create a complete iOS application.

projects.title: OpenSmartHub
projects.description: A smart home solution to all your separated "smart" devices that you can host yourself, customize, and add functionality to. It comprises of both a local-hub built on Node.js running on a Raspberry Pi 2 and an online-hub on Azure built with Node.js and authenticated with PassportJS. It has the ability to talk to Amazon Echo, ZWave Devices, Wemo devices, Yamaha Receivers, Particle devices, and maker projects!

projects.title: TheGiftLi.st
projects.description: A website, iOS app, and Android app where we combined social networking with a singular shopping wishlist.

organizations.name: Climbers of Color
organizations.description:
• Managed the social media for the non-profit "Climbers of Color".
• Analyzed metrics to improve engagement and audience retention in order to further the mission of promoting diversity, equity and inclusion in the climbing and mountaineering community by developing leaders of color.

organizations.name: StreetMeetWA
organizations.description: Hosted and organized monthly events for photographers and other creatives throughout Washington with a regular attendance of around 100 people. The goal of these events was to grow a community of creatives in the Pacific Northwest and allow for more in-person interactions in a social media driven world.
